raw_articles.title: General Motors is driving toward supply chain resiliency
raw_articles.summary: The automaker is upping its domestic production investments while securing memory supply to shield rising commodity and logistics costs.

raw_articles.title: Fashion brands plan to consolidate sourcing over next 2 years
raw_articles.summary: Companies are maintaining the geographic diversity they already have while prioritizing flexibility and compliance rigor, per a 2026 fashion benchmarking study.

raw_articles.title: How Walmart uses AI to limit weather disruptions in its supply chain
raw_articles.summary: The retailer uses technology to determine how to reroute or position inventory before severe weather events occur, an executive told Supply Chain Dive.
